Name: Magic Rock Candy Improved
Author: DavidCPU
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install SMAPI[/url]  at least 4.4.0+.[/*]
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]  mod[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][size=5]How to customize[/size]
Open config.json with a text editor. Each buff has a name and a number.

[size=5]Buff order[/size]
[list]
[*]  "Farming_Cultivo": 0,
  "Fishing_Pesca": 2,
  "Mining_Mineracao": 2,
  "Combat_Combate": 5,
  "Luck_Sorte": 7,
  "Foraging_Coleta": 0,
  "MaxEnergy_EnergiaMaxima": 0,
  "Magnetism_Magnetismo": 3,
  "Speed_Velocidade": 3,
  "Defense_Defesa": 5,
  "Attack_Ataque": 5,
  [/*]
[*]At the end, "DurationSeconds_DuracaoSegundos": 504 uses REAL seconds.
"DurationSeconds_DuracaoSegundos": 504 [/*]
[/list][size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and Androidc[/*]
[*]It works in single-player and multiplayer modes.[/*]
[/list]❤️ Support the development
